about: The introitus of the formulary “Chair of Saint Peter the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The Lord established a covenant of peace with him and made him a prince, that the dignity of the priesthood might be his forever. Remember David, O Lord, and all his meekness. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. The Lord established a covenant of peace with him and made him a prince, that the dignity of the priesthood might be his forever.
